buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PREQUALIFYING REQUIREMENT FOR TENDER · The bidder must have supplied the material mentioned in the price bid or same type of material elsewher e in the UPPTCL/ Govt. utility. · Bidder must be registered with GST. · Bidder must be registered with ESIC Department. · Bidder must be registered with E.P.F Department. · Bidder must be registered in Labour department of Uttar Pradesh. · Bidder must have past experience of same/similar services & must provide details of similar work in UPPT CL/Power Grid/state transmission corporation and completion certificate for reference, failing which the bid is liable to be rejected. · Copy of latest Income Tax clearance certificate/Return filed and PAN Card. · Class (A) category electrical license certificate of Uttar Pradesh. · No Joint Venture is acceptable. · Average annual financial turnover during the last 05 years, ending current financial year, should be at lea st 100% (Minimum) of the estimated cost. It should be C.A. Certified (With UDIN No.) · Bidder must have past experience of same/similar services & must provide details of similar work in UPPT CL/Power Grid/state transmission corporation during last 05 year ending last day of month previous to the one in which applications are invited should be either of the following :- o Three similar completed supply/work not less than the amount equal to 40% of the estimate d cost. Or o Two similar completed supply/work not less than the amount equal to 50% of the estimated cost. Or o One similar completed supply/work not less than the amount equal to 80% of the estimated cost. · · Bidder must submit character certificate issued by District magistrate and it should be valid on bid submi ssion date. · If rates quoted by the firm are below 10% of the tender cost then, 5% @ 0.5% for up to 10% and 1% for e ach percent above 10% of estimated value, additional B.G./Performance guarantee will be taken in the for m of FDR/TDR only. The contractor shall be submit additional security/performance guarantee as per U.P. Govt. order no. 622/23-122021-2 audit /08 T.C.-2 dated 08-06-2012 which was adopted in its 53rd BOD me eting of U.P. Power Transmission on dated 27.06.2017 before agreement, as applicable. · The bidder should not have been blacklisted or disqualified for non-performance in any of the Gov ernment utilities in the past Five Years as on the date of bid opening and bidder shall furnish self- d eclaration to this effect on a non- judicial stamp of Rs. 100/- failing which the bid is liable to be reje cted. NOTE: · All the documents should be self-attested · Bidder shall have to submit the documentary evidence in support of above pre-qualifying requirement.

SPECIAL TERM & CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT 1 -Scope of Work: - The scope of services to be provided by contractor “for R epairing and overhauling of CCTVs (Bullet/PTZ) Cameras at 400 KV Substation Pali Greater Noida.Under E 400KV S/S Division Greater Noida.” 2 -T & P:- All T & P required for proper execution of works shall be arranged by the contra ctor himself, at his own cost. 3- LABOUR: - Gardeners & skilled labors for said work shall be arranged by the contractor at his own cost. In this connection department does not take any responsibility. However, person deployed by the contractor found including in the act of union, indiscipline or anything objectionable, shall be removed from site if asked to do so by engineer. 4- ELECTRICITY RULE: - All construction work shall be carried out as per relevant provision of Indian Elec tricity Rule 1956 and Indian Electricity Act. 1910 or any amendment thereof. Te chnical specification of the contract and any other manual referred to therein sh all be strictly adhered to. 5- SAFETY & WORKMANSHIP: - All safety rules shall be strictly observed by the contractor during the entire peri od of execution of work. However, in case of any major or minor accident, the c ontractor shall be wholly responsible for all consequences arising thereof includi ng payment of compensation under ‘Workers’ compensation Act and the depart ment shall in no way be responsible of this. JE & AE shall ensure that at no level the safety ruled are violated. 6- MATERIAL: - All required material for carried out the work shall be provided by the seller at h is own cost/ subject to BOQ or SOW. 7- THEFT & LOSSES: - In case of any theft and losses of material, reported by security guard / Contract or, necessary FIR shall be lodged by concerned JE with the concerning Police Sta tion. 8- INSURANCE: - The responsibility to maintain adequate insurance coverage at all times during period of contract for safety of staff deployed and spares handed over for maint enance shall be that of contractor. The contractor shall also take necessary insu rance to indemnity third party risk arising out of work to be done by him at his o

wn cost. The department shall not be responsible in any way in case of any mis happening. The contractor shall provide with copy of all insurance policies & do cuments to Executive Engineer. 9- SUPERVISION: - All work shall be supervised by Assistant Engineer/ JE shall be over all in charge of supervision of each & every work in the contract. JE entrusted to get the wor k done, shall personally ensures that the execution is done exclusively as per specification of contract. In case of any deviation, he will immediately write to c ontractor under intimation to Assistant Engineer/ Engineer in Charge. 10- ENGINEER: - Executive Engineer, Electricity 400KV S/S Division, UPPTCL, Greater Noida shall be Engineer of the contract. 11- VERIFICATION OF BILLS: - After the work has been satisfactorily completed the work Contractor will submit bill to concerned JE / AE for recording in MB and verification. Any delay beyond t hat shall have to be justified by JE&AE in the covering letter. There should not b e any substantial gap between the date of verification of bills in MB and its sub mission in the office of EE. 12- DISPUTE: - In case of any dispute in respect of interpretation of any provision in the contrac t of any nature in respect of the work, the decision of the superintending engine er, Electricity Transmission circle, UPPTCL, Greater Noida shall be final & bindin g upon both the parties. 13- JURISDICTION OF COURT: - The contract shall be governed by the Law of Government of India for the time i n force in District Gautam Buddh Nagar in the state of U.P. and shall be under t he jurisdiction of Hon’ble High Court, Allahabad. No other court shall have jurisd iction to entertain the same. 14- PENALTY: - The Contractor shall have to executive execute the above work within stipulated time allowed, failing which a penalty @ ½% per week on remaining w ork subject to maximum of 10% of amount of the work shall be levied and recov ered from the contractor’s bills. 15 -FINANCIAL CONDITIONS PRICE: - To be quoted on rate schedule enclosed. DAMAGE OF EQUIPMENT: - The contractor shall ensure to follow all instructio ns issued by concerned AE/JE. Incase damage of any equipment, if it is found du e to negligence of contractor’s employee/ labour, same shall be recovered from contractor’s bill. 16-STATUTORY DUTIES AND TAXES:-

a. LOCAL TAXES AND LEVIES: - GST will be charge as per applicable. b. INCOME TAX: - The contractor shall be liable and responsible for payment o f such taxes if attracted under the provision of law. 17- EARNEST MONEY & SECURITY DEPOSIT: - The Contractor shall furnish security @ 1% of total value of the contract on start of work otherwise shall be deducted from 1st running bill. The amount of Earnes t money will be converted into security deposit. The security money shall be released after 6 months from the date of successful completion of work. The security money shall be forfeited either in whole or in part at the absolute d iscretion of the engineer, if the contractor fails or neglect to observe or perform any his obligation under the contract. 18-COMPLETION PERIOD: Period for this work shall be for 01 Months from the date of agreement. 19-TERMS OF PAYMENT: - 1. 90% payment will be released after satisfactory completion of work. 2. To claim 100% payment, the contractor shall furnish a valid BG/CDR/FDR of 10% amount of contract value (or the amount of running bill as the cas e may be) else 90% payment shall be released. 3. Balance 10% payment or FDR/CDR of 10% amount shall be withheld as p erformance guarantee and shall be released after 6 months period from t he date of completion of work after necessary certification by JE/AE that t he work has been completed satisfactorily as per specification and nothin g is outstanding against the contractor against this agreement. 20 -MODE OF PAYMENT: - All payment shall be made through RTGS. 21 -WITH HOLDING OF PAYMENT: - The payment can be withheld on account of following at the discretion of e ngineer a) Violation of any contractual obligation on part of the contractor. b) Failure by the contractor to make due payment of material or labour employe d by him. c) In sufficient progress of work. When the grounds for withholding the payment s are removed, payment shall be made without any delay. .
